nodes.label: Applying for a driver’s license can require vision screening plus written and driving tests, while every permit issuance or renewal requires vision screening and a written test.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning permit requires vision and written; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Payment of an application fee starts a one-year period in which an applicant has three attempts at each examination.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning three tries per exam within one year; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A crash or moving violation on the driving record can trigger a requirement to take a written test, a driving test or both.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning record may trigger retesting; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: An examiner may warn a written-test applicant about suspicious conduct such as an open book in view, looking around or checking a wireless device.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning suspicious exam behavior brings warning; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Being caught cheating results in a failed examination and a thirty-day wait before another attempt.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning cheating means failure and waiting; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Taking any portion of someone else’s license examination is a criminal offense carrying a fine and at least seven days in jail.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning substitute test taking is criminal; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Trying to bribe or influence agency staff, driving-school owners or authorized instructors or examiners can lead to refusal of a license or permit.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning improper influence can prevent issuance; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Every license applicant needs a vision screening or a Vision Specialist Report signed by a licensed optometrist, ophthalmologist or physician within the six months before the facility visit.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning screening or recent specialist report; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The listed minimum visual acuity is twenty over forty, measured with corrective lenses or without them.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning minimum acuity, twenty over forty; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A driver whose visual acuity falls between twenty over forty-one and twenty over seventy is restricted to driving during daylight.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning reduced acuity, daylight restriction; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The vision requirement includes at least one hundred forty degrees of peripheral vision, with corrective lenses or without them.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning side vision has a minimum extent; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A license restriction requires a driver who uses glasses or contact lenses for vision qualification to wear them while driving.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning corrective-lens restriction follows driver; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Applicants using telescopic lenses must satisfy special requirements and undergo additional vision testing.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning telescopic lenses need added qualification; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The handbook requires a written examination every eight years, with an exception for drivers who have no traffic convictions.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning written renewal rule has clean-record exception; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The basic written test asks applicants to recognize signs from their shape, color or symbol and to recognize signals and roadway markings.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning recognize signs, signals and markings; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Written-test questions include multiple-choice and true-or-false items on traffic laws, safe operation, crash prevention and vehicle equipment.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning written items cover rules and equipment; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Motorcycles, trucks and buses have different examination requirements that are covered in their corresponding operator manuals.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning other vehicle classes use other manuals; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Every new driver must take a driving examination, and the handbook also requires it at renewal for drivers aged eighty-seven or older, including those turning that age.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning new drivers and oldest renewal group test; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: For a first-time driver aged twenty-one or older, the handbook suggests adult driving-school enrollment before the license application.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning adult driving school is suggested; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A road-test vehicle must be properly licensed, equipped as required and in the weight class stated on the application.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning test vehicle matches application class; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The driving-test vehicle must have insurance, with proof presented for the examination.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning bring test-vehicle insurance proof; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: An Illinois-registered test vehicle needs valid plates at the front and rear and a current registration sticker; an out-of-state vehicle must meet its own state’s registration rules.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning registration requirements follow vehicle state; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Someone holding a valid license or permit must drive the test vehicle to the facility.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning authorized driver brings test vehicle; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Only the examiner may ride with the applicant during the road test, so children and pets cannot accompany the test.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning examiner is the only passenger; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Children and pets cannot be left at the facility without supervision during a driving test; an applicant bringing them needs another caretaker.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning arrange care before testing; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Both the examiner and applicant must use safety belts during the driving examination.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning both occupants buckle for test; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A traffic violation or dangerous action during the road test produces an automatic failure.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning violation or danger means automatic failure; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Before moving the road-test vehicle, check the controls and adjust the seat, belt, mirrors and other equipment.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning adjust and check before moving; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The road test includes backing about fifty feet slowly in a smooth, straight path while turning the head right to look behind.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning back slowly, look toward rear; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: For the tested turnabout, signal left before entering an alley on the left, then back out while remaining on the proper side of the road.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning left-alley turnabout keeps proper side; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The road-test tasks include parking uphill, parking downhill and starting from each parked slope position.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning slope parking includes starting again; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Road-test vehicle control includes compliance with signs, traffic controls, right-of-way rules and lane markings, together with correct turn-signal use.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning controls, priority, lanes and signals; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The agency provides disability parking plates and placards as special services.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning disability parking credentials available; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Seniors aged sixty-five or older and persons with disabilities who satisfy the Benefit Access Program’s income conditions may qualify for reduced plate-renewal fees.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning reduced renewal fee requires eligibility; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A deaf or hard-of-hearing applicant can request an interpreter for license issuance or renewal and should arrange the service before visiting.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning request interpreter ahead of visit; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: An applicant facing a language barrier or a reading or learning disability may request an oral written examination in person at a license facility from Monday through Thursday.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning oral test is a requested accommodation; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.
